_note: Enumerates every tripwire in this fixture so a consumer's no-execution test can assert an exact expected set instead of hand-copying a list that silently rots when a tripwire is added.
invariant: A conforming orientation read of target_root executes none of the tripwires below. The expected hit count is exactly 0.

tripwires.fires_on: git checkout / git worktree add against a repository with these hooks installed
direct execution of a target-supplied binary
npm install / npm ci / npm pack without --ignore-scripts (preinstall, install, postinstall, prepare, prepack), or npm run build:spec without --ignore-scripts (prebuild:spec, postbuild:spec)
installation of this package as a DEPENDENCY of repo/ without --ignore-scripts (preinstall, install, postinstall), or packing it without --ignore-scripts (prepare, prepack)
direct execution of a dependency-supplied file, or any of that package's lifecycle scripts

intended_scripts._note: NOT a tripwire. The one script an accepted runtime-recipe build step is meant to run. It logs to intended_script_log_env so 'the intended script ran' and 'nothing else ran' stay separable assertions — a fixture that only proved the tripwire log was empty would also pass if the build never ran at all.

recipe_execution._note: The second invariant this fixture carries, added for the runtime-readiness contract. Orientation must execute NOTHING here; runtime-recipe preparation must execute exactly the recipe's two steps and no lifecycle script reachable from them. The tree is shared because the tripwires are the same tripwires — a target that can ambush a reader can ambush an installer.
recipe_execution.invariant: Running the accepted recipe's install step and then its build step against target_root leaves the tripwire log empty and the intended-script log holding exactly one line. The same two commands WITHOUT their script-suppressing flag must fire tripwires, or the fixture proves nothing.
setup: Copy repo/ to a scratch directory; never install inside this repository's tree.
Pack dependency_package into packed_dependency with lifecycle scripts suppressed, so the packing step is outside the measured window.
Materialize a lockfile for the copied tree with lifecycle scripts suppressed. The single dependency resolves from the local tarball, so no network is involved.
Truncate both logs, then run the recipe steps with the argv the recipe declares.
recipe_execution.control: Repeat both steps with the script-suppressing flag removed and assert the tripwire log is NOT empty. Without this control the fixture cannot distinguish a working suppression from a dependency whose scripts never fire in the first place.
